impl_result.notes: Anti-shortcut: adjacency.json loaded with 1000s of non-zero neighbour profiles; deps_fit.fit() calls R.realize() from scratch; params contain only statistical knobs (density, biome weights, spatial signature = median distances, not tile positions). gate_check.notes: Re-ran g2_validity.py --seeds 10: pass_rate=1.0 (10/10 seeds), exceeding the ≥0.9 bar. pytest 26/26. Adjacency weights are corpus-learned share*deg Poisson parameters — non-zero, real. The 'oracle' in extract.py is corpus extraction only, not on the generation path. No banned patterns found.
